picks.editorial_note: DOE selected this Fermilab-led team under its new Genesis Mission to build AI systems that control particle accelerator performance in real time — a flagship national program applying AI to frontier physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million UK government-backed trial will test AI-driven flight path adjustments to cut aviation's contrail-driven climate warming — a rare case of AI research moving directly into real-world climate policy and airline operations.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on more than $42 million in NSF grants to build national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, strengthening the research backbone that other AI science depends on.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: A $9 million NSF-funded iDLab will give researchers browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the NAIRR effort to democratize AI computing infrastructure across academia.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are pairing AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials — a concrete industry-academia bet on AI-driven materials science.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: An AI-powered coastal 'digital twin' built by Old Dominion University proved itself during actual Norfolk flooding, showing AI climate-resilience tools working under real disaster conditions rather than in simulation alone.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo are combining an AI drug-discovery platform with biomedical research expertise in a new joint research cluster, a substantive industry-academia bet on AI-accelerated pharmaceutical development.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital launched a joint lab to develop next-generation data storage for AI workloads, addressing a critical infrastructure bottleneck as AI data demands grow.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew's five-year center will translate AI and computer-vision research into surgical robotics, a notable academia-industry pipeline from lab breakthroughs to clinical tools.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to any specific training example — is a significant finding for ongoing debates over AI copyright, transparency, and provenance.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data
